paragraphs: R' Elazar ben Pila (a Tanna) — Tahorot, chapter 7, mishnah 9.
R' Yudan ben Pila — Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 9, halakhah 5.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״ז מ״ט and פ״ט ה״ה explicitly give Tahorot chapter 7 mishnah 9 and Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot chapter 9 halakhah 5, without independently checked editions.
The two attested sons do not establish one father Pila. Tanna is an explicit qualifier for Elazar only, not personal-title evidence; both title abbreviations remain R'.
